subject: Superintendent Welcome Address
overview: Superintendent Dr. Marice Edouard-Vincent introduced the Medford Public Schools mission and core values to the community. The address emphasized inclusivity, district history, and the importance of collaboration between caregivers and educators.

items.title: Superintendent's Welcome Message
items.summary: Dr. Marice Edouard-Vincent outlined the district's guiding pillars of achievement, collaboration, equity, and support while emphasizing the value of diversity within the school community.
